name: uv
description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
one_liner: A much faster replacement for pip and other Python package tools that installs your project's dependencies in a fraction of the time.
buyer: A data/ML team with slow CI pipelines who wants to cut build times and infrastructure cost, backed by Astral's commercial tooling.
business_use_cases: An ML platform team swaps pip for uv in CI to cut dependency install time and compute cost at scale.
A consultancy offers 'Python toolchain modernization' engagements that migrate legacy pip/poetry projects to uv.
A SaaS product with Python workers reduces cold-start/deploy time by adopting uv, improving customer-facing latency.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid migration consulting for companies moving large Python monorepos from pip/poetry to uv.

steal_this: Build a one-click 'migrate my repo to uv' CLI script and sell it as a $200 fixed-price service to small Python shops this weekend.
